scripts.title: Set up a no-show fee that only applies after the second miss
scripts.modelled_on: "You're losing $400 a week to no-shows" (2026-01-19, 18,870 views)

hook_0_3s.on_screen: Set up a no-show fee that only applies after the second miss.
hook_0_3s.spoken: Charging everyone for one missed appointment loses you regulars. Here's the rule that doesn't.

beats.beat: Hook: a calendar with two red no-show slots on the same client.
Setup: 'A flat no-show fee annoys the clients who miss once a year. Most of the cost comes from a few repeat no-shows.'
Open the booking settings and turn on the no-show fee, set to apply from the second missed appointment in 12 months.
Add the line clients see when they book: the fee, when it applies and how to cancel in time. Read it out.
Payoff: show the reminder text with the policy line, then the client who rebooked instead of missing.
CTA: 'Copy the wording from the caption.'

scripts.share_payoff: the policy wording itself, written into the caption so owners save it
scripts.cta: Copy the wording from the caption.
scripts.caption: Set up a no-show fee that only applies after the second miss. The wording: a fee of half the service price from the second missed appointment in 12 months, waived with 24 hours' notice. #noshows #noshowpolicy #bookingapp #salonowner

scripts.title: Build a deposit rule for services over an hour
scripts.modelled_on: "Build a deposit rule that only applies to first-time clients" (2026-03-03, 23,640 views)

hook_0_3s.on_screen: Build a deposit rule for services over an hour.
hook_0_3s.spoken: An empty one-hour slot costs you more than three short ones. Protect that one first.

beats.beat: Hook: a 90-minute colour appointment slot going grey as the client cancels.
Setup: 'Deposits on every service put people off. Deposits on long services almost nobody minds.'
In the service list, filter to services over 60 minutes and turn on a 20% deposit for those only.
Book one as a client on a phone: show the deposit step and the cancellation line before payment.
Payoff: the week view with every long slot marked as paid in advance.
CTA: 'Follow for the cancellation wording next week.'

scripts.share_payoff: the before and after week view, the result an owner sends to their business partner
scripts.cta: Follow for the cancellation wording next week.
scripts.caption: Build a deposit rule for services over an hour. A 20% deposit on services over an hour, nothing on the rest. Clients see the cancellation line before they pay. #depositpolicy #bookingdeposit #bookingapp #salonowner

scripts.title: Make a 24-hour reminder that clients actually reply to
scripts.modelled_on: "Make your reminder texts sound like you, not a robot" (2026-04-11, 30,620 views)

hook_0_3s.on_screen: Make a 24-hour reminder that clients actually reply to.
hook_0_3s.spoken: If your reminder doesn't ask for a reply, you find out about the no-show when the chair is empty.

beats.beat: Hook: a phone buzzing with 'C' replies coming in one after another.
Setup: 'A reminder that just reminds gets ignored. A reminder that asks a question gets answers.'
Write the text on screen: name, time, service, then 'Reply C to confirm or R to reschedule'.
Set it to send 24 hours before by text, with the email as a backup, and show where clients' replies land.
Payoff: tomorrow's list with every appointment marked confirmed or moved.
CTA: 'Steal the text from the caption.'

scripts.share_payoff: the reminder text, short enough to screenshot
scripts.cta: Steal the text from the caption.
scripts.caption: Make a 24-hour reminder that clients actually reply to. The text: Hi [name], see you tomorrow at [time] for [service]. Reply C to confirm or R to reschedule. #appointmentreminders #textreminders #bookingapp #salonowner
